{{Top|leg}}
'''Prospecting droids''' were a type of [[Mining droid/Legends|mining droid]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] issued an [[Ordnance and Supply/Legends|Ordnance and Supply]] alert, advising all personnel to be on the lookout for leads to acquiring the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>
